ideas.question: Is SUID associated with distinct sleep environments compared to non-SUID infant deaths?
ideas.comparison: SUID cases from ncfrp_v51 compared with other cause-of-death categories within ncfrp_v51 (2008-2019).
ideas.why_open: While the case series records bed sharing, it is unclear if this reflects a unique risk factor for SUID or a more general sleep environment characteristic. If distinct, it may imply specific preventive measures.
